source: Dataset-21 D1 real measured RSS; D3 is never an evaluation input
claim_source: Synthetic normal RID claims constructed from interpolated measured UAV GPS; not captured RID payloads
sparse_availability_design: K1..5 x span0.02/0.1/0.2/0.5, lag0 and no missing
K1/4/5 x missing0.1/0.3/0.5, span0.2 and lag0
K4/5 x lag0.05/0.2/1/10/3600, span0.2 and no missing
geometric_evaluation_gate: Verified receiver positions and shared vertical reference required; otherwise FPR/TPR are null, NOT_RUN, not zero
multi_receiver_regime: Nearest-time static-position approximation; NOT same-transmission multi-receiver RSS
limitations: One actual flight; synthetic missing-mask seeds are not independent flights
K2/K3 unsupported by existing GhostBuster 3D implementation
Receiver latitude/longitude or height must not be guessed from a plot
No real transmitter power modification; dB perturbations are synthetic only
